For the armor in Dungeons, see MCD:Armor. For other uses, see Armor (disambiguation).

Armor is a category of equippable items that can be physically worn by a hero. They increase the hero's defense, allowing damage taken to be smaller, yet do not increase the main health value from 100. They can provide one or more bonus effects unique to each armor piece (depending on the rarity of the item).

Armor sets

Armor sets are groups of armor items that come in four pieces, including helmets, chestplates, leggings, and boots. Sets can be mixed-and-matched for different combinations of stats and effects.

Enchanting

Main article: MCD2:Enchanting

All armor can be enchanted or disenchanted at an enchantsmith, granting a bonus ability to an armor piece. Each piece can only hold one enchantment at a time, and enchantments can be upgraded up to two times to maximize their potency.

  • Bottomless Brew is the only armor enchantment that’s only able to be applied to one specific armor piece, that being the chestplate.

History

May 29, 2026 Armor sets can be first seen equipped on heroes in the key art.
June 7, 2026 Several new armor sets are visible throughout the reveal trailer.
